column1: # Every entry is an input that either tripped an invariant or
# reached an outcome signature no earlier entry had reached. The
# recorded vector is asserted EXACTLY on replay, so an entry is a
# regression test forever: a change that alters any field fails
# the gate and has to be explained rather than absorbed.
# The three cost columns (peak_depth, peak_frames, fuel_spent) are
# also the recorded performance baseline R30.M9-003 (#1087) gates
# on. See design/acpi/perf-methodology.md for why the budget is
# expressed in work rather than in milliseconds.
